newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Petrobas confirms new gas field discovery.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Petrobas confirms new gas field discovery.

text.p: Brazil state oil company Petrobras has confirmed through further tests the discovery of a new gas field off the coast of Espirito Santos state, the company said in a statement.
The well, 3-ESS-82, is located 50 km from the shore in waters of 67 meters and extends to a depth of 3,298 meters.
Tests show a daily production of 600,000 cubic meters a day and a reserve estimated at around five billion cubic meters.
Petrobras has also finished evaluating an offshore oil well between the Marimba and Espadarte fields off the Rio de Janeiro state coast.
The well, 4-MA-12-RJS, is expected to see production of 9,500 barrels per day and should add around 80 million barrels to the total oil reserves in the Marimba field.
